scientific_role: response-blind finite world-universe prerequisite for the independent Azores EOG confirmation

geography.threshold_rule: linear quantiles of all positive upper-triangle pairwise distances among the nine frozen nodes

environment.standardization: within each frozen climate representation and variable, subtract the nine-node mean and divide by the nine-node sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
environment.metric: euclidean distance in the five standardized BIO variables
environment.threshold_rule: linear quantiles of all positive upper-triangle pairwise environmental distances

world_definition.edge_rule: an undirected edge exists when pairwise geographic distance is <= the world's geography threshold and, for environmental worlds, pairwise environmental distance is also <= that representation's environmental threshold
world_definition.component_rule: connected components of the exact undirected edge set; isolated nodes remain singleton components

identity_rule: retain every world ID, family, exact edge set, component partition and deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; do not average or union worlds before the later confirmation comparison
stop_rules: do not change the 20-world family after species-island incidence or outcome information is opened
do not add or remove nodes, climate variables, climate representations or threshold quantiles based on world structure
do not parse the Azores species-incidence archive in Gate 4
if the exact 20-world universe cannot be built from the frozen Gate 3 table, stop Gate 4 rather than rescue it with a new representation
